# Synth

Synth lets you query any CSV file with real SQL, or in plain English,
directly in your browser. No database setup, no SQL Server, no
installation — upload a CSV and it becomes a live SQLite database
running client-side, entirely in your browser tab.

## Who it's for

- People who know SQL and don't want to set up a server for one file
- People who don't know SQL and want to ask questions in plain English
- Analysts working with CSVs up to 500,000 rows

## Key facts

- Runs 100% client-side via SQLite compiled to WebAssembly (sql.js) — your data never leaves your browser unless you sign in and explicitly save it to the cloud
- Free tier: single-table workspaces, up to 50,000 rows, no sign-in required
- Premium: $9.99, paid once (not a subscription) — multi-table workspaces (up to 10 tables), table renaming, cross-table AI joins, relationship detection, and CSVs up to 500,000 rows
- Built-in AI assistant supports two modes: SQL Mode (returns a runnable SQL query) and General Mode (returns a plain-English answer, no SQL)
